E_auctifera_lowercased.verdict: OBSERVATION — case-sensitive lookup: lowercase SF org id doesn't match the case-preserved storage. In practice packages always send the canonical UserInfo.getOrganizationId() casing, so this is not a defect.

impression_POST_Auctifera.error: surveyId is not eligible for this feature context
impression_POST_Auctifera.root_cause: The impression endpoint validates against selectEligibleSurveysForFeature (triggerMode='featureTrigger'). Survey #2 is afterLogin, so it's not returned by that path, so the validator rejects with 400. Consequence: maxImpressions counter never increments.

dismissal_POST_Auctifera.error: surveyId is not eligible for this feature context
dismissal_POST_Auctifera.root_cause: Same as impression — dismissal endpoint uses the same validator, rejects with 400. Consequence: maxDismissals counter never increments.

IM_1185_preexistente_confirmed_live.impact_on_user_screenshot_params: Max dismissals per period, Tries between shows, Max shows per day are PERSISTED correctly (maxImpressions=1, maxDismissals=1 accepted by the update), but NEVER ENFORCED for after-login general surveys because the impression/dismissal endpoints reject the tracking POSTs with 400. Defect IM-1185 High, Is Ready for Dev.

overlap_protection_bonus_evidence.attempted_update: Activate Survey #2 while Survey #1 (audience=everyone) still active
overlap_protection_bonus_evidence.error: An active general survey already applies to this audience (survey 1).
overlap_protection_bonus_evidence.verdict: PASS — server enforces that two active general surveys with overlapping audience cannot coexist. This bonus finding strengthens AC5+AC6 audience-isolation guarantees.

final_verdict.audience_isolation_cross_org: PASS — Auctifera (in audience) receives Survey #2; VNFP, other-org, and no-org (not in audience) all correctly return empty lists via after-login endpoint AND explicit reason='audience' via admin respondent-state.
final_verdict.config_persistence: PASS — maxImpressions=1 + maxDismissals=1 + triggerDetails='generalTrigger=afterLogin, loginDelaySeconds=30' + audienceDetails='00DEm00000V5eRWMAZ' persist correctly (PUT /api/admin/surveys/2 returned 200).
final_verdict.config_enforcement_at_runtime: BLOCKED by IM-1185 preexistente High — the parameters cannot fire because impression/dismissal POSTs are rejected with 400. This is a preexisting defect (not introduced by any of the 4 QA'd tickets); dev is on it.
